characters.name: Kaito
characters.quote: Balance is a blade with two edges.
characters.bio: A wandering swordless ronin who fights with disciplined ki. Every tool he needs, none he does not.

characters.name: Bruno
characters.quote: Come here. This will only hurt forever.
characters.bio: A lumber-camp strongman. If he gets his hands on you, the round is half over.

characters.name: Vesper
characters.quote: Every step you take is one I already aimed at.
characters.bio: A ridgeline hunter who has never lost a fight she started at range. Up close is another story.

characters.name: Rieko
characters.bio: Street-race champion turned fighter. Only knows one gear: forward.

characters.name: Grigor
characters.quote: I have been waiting. That was the whole plan.
characters.bio: Bare-knuckle champion of nine ports. Patient, immovable, and then suddenly on top of you.

characters.name: Anira
characters.bio: Raised on temple rooftops. Treats the ground as a suggestion.

characters.name: Tomas
characters.quote: Which of me were you training against?
characters.bio: Studied two opposing schools and refused to pick one. Flows like water, then sets like stone.

characters.name: Nadia
characters.bio: Bargained with her own shadow. Now it fights beside her — on a timer, and a leash.

characters.name: Sable
characters.bio: A duelist who has made a career of the half-second after your attack misses.

characters.name: Goliath
characters.quote: The distance was never yours to set.
characters.bio: Nobody agrees on what he is. Everybody agrees to stay outside his arm span.
